title: Linhof Master Technika 4x5 Large Format Sheet Film
purpose: Unsurpassed museum-grade fine art and architectural resolution with Scheimpflug plane-of-focus control and zero vertical converging lines.

sensor_and_optics.camera_system: Linhof Master Technika 4x5 Large Format Field Camera
sensor_and_optics.sensor_type: 4x5 inch Sheet Film (102x127mm individual film sheet)
sensor_and_optics.sensor_dimensions: 102x127mm 4x5 inch large format sheet film negative
sensor_and_optics.full_frame_equivalent: ~45mm normal field of view with massive image circle coverage
sensor_and_optics.iso_base: Kodak Professional Ektar 100 ultra-fine grain color negative sheet film
sensor_and_optics.dynamic_range: 15 stops of expansive optical latitude with microscopic resolution
sensor_and_optics.shutter: Copal No. 0 mechanical leaf shutter, heavy studio tripod mount

lighting_and_exposure.primary_lighting: Controlled architectural daylight balanced with subtle interior fill strobe
lighting_and_exposure.light_transport: Pure physical light transport, immaculate tonal gradients across polished stone, glass, and wood

surface_rendering: Microscopic detail resolution: individual building material textures, concrete aggregate, wood grain, micro-abrasions
Kodak Ektar 100 grainless clarity: ultra-vivid, color-saturated reality without digital sharpness artifacts
Infinite depth of field across diagonal planes via Scheimpflug optical tilt
depth_and_optics: Perfect optical perspective correction via rise/fall lens standards: parallel vertical lines with zero keystone distortion
Corner-to-corner tack-sharp optical MTF fidelity across the entire 4x5 sheet
Clean, uncompressed rectilinear projection without barrel or pincushion distortion

execution_directive: Enforce 4x5 large-format sheet film museum fidelity. Scheimpflug optical plane alignment, zero keystone distortion, Ektar 100 resolution, and immaculate material micro-detail.
